title: Conic and local-ring structure of one rational-double-point blowup
statement: Let $(A,\mathfrak m,k)$ be a commutative normal Nagata local domain of dimension $2$ defining a rational singularity [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring], [def-weil-pbc-nagata-ring], [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring], [def-per-rational-surface-singularity]. Suppose its maximal-ideal-adic completion is normal [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], $A$ is not regular [def-weil-regular-scheme], and $A$ is Gorenstein, meaning that its injective dimension as an $A$-module is finite. Put $X=\operatorname{Bl}_{\mathfrak m}(\operatorname{Spec}A)$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], [def-nagata-global-blowup]. Then $X$ is an integral normal Noetherian scheme of dimension $2$ [def-pc-integral-scheme]. Every closed point $p$ of $X$ lies over $\mathfrak m$; its local ring $S=\mathcal O_{X,p}$ is a normal Nagata Gorenstein local domain of dimension $2$ with normal completion. The map $A\to S$ is injective and local, induces an isomorphism of fraction fields, and is a localization of a finitely generated $A$-algebra [def-sc-function-field], [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra], [def-weil-pbc-module-localization]. Moreover $\dim_k\mathfrak m^n/\mathfrak m^{n+1}=2n+1$ for all $n\geq0$. For any minimal generators $x_1,x_2,x_3$, there is a nonzero homogeneous quadratic polynomial $q$, unique up to a scalar in $k^*$, such that $t_i\mapsto x_i\bmod\mathfrak m^2$ identifies $\operatorname{gr}_{\mathfrak m}A$ with $k[t_1,t_2,t_3]/(q)$ [def-weil-pbc-associated-graded-ring], [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring]. The exceptional closed fibre $E$ is the plane conic $V(q)\subset\mathbf P^2_k$ [def-pc-projective-space-twist]. On the chart $A[\mathfrak m/x_i]\subset\operatorname{Frac}A$ its ideal is generated by $x_i$.
